metric_ref.description: Identifier of the Metric definition used; a full Sema ID when the definition is a vocabulary pattern

value.description: Number or finite numerical structure conforming to the referenced Metric's value_schema

observed_at.description: Optional time, interval, event, batch, or immutable version that scopes the reading

dimensions.description: Optional labels that locate the reading within dimensions allowed by the Metric definition

mechanism: A realized value under a referenced {{metric}} definition. The reading binds its value to the definition that supplies the target property, derivation rule, and value schema. Observation time and dimensions may scope the value without redefining it.
gloss: Quantitative value bound to a Metric definition
invariants: Definition Conformance: `value` conforms to the `value_schema` declared by the definition identified by `metric_ref`.
failure_modes: Definition Mismatch: a value produced under one {{metric}} definition is interpreted or compared under another.
